name: Transaction Identifications 35
definition: Provides transaction type and identification information.

AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification.name: Account Owner Transaction Identification
AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as known by the account owner (or the instructing party managing the account).

AccountServicerTransactionIdentification.name: Account Servicer Transaction Identification
AccountServicerTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as known by the account servicer.

CommonIdentification.name: Common Identification
CommonIdentification.definition: Unique reference agreed upon by the two trade counterparties to identify the trade.

NoAccountOwnerTransactionIdentificationR.definition: If no reference is available for the AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification, for example, the transaction was sent by fax, then the AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification must be NONREF.
